assignment.placement: Campus-coordinate massing; retains existing identity/campus placement. No manifest origin or placement marker changed.

starting_asset.source: Existing asset before rebuild, reopened using Blender 4.5.15.
starting_asset.shape: One rectangular box; no differentiated building footprint or facade features.

geometry_edits: Retained the exact 13-vertex Purdue BuildingShapes FID 274 exterior footprint and campus coordinates.

Partitioned the footprint into the main block (838.21 m2), low entrance wing (62.58 m2), and lower southeast extension (303.68 m2); the internal partitions are interpretations of the Purdue 2020 oblique photo and IGIO 2023 orthophoto, not surveyed internal building boundaries.
Added three distinct estimated roof/wall zones: main eave 10.45 m / ridge 14.6304 m, entrance wing eave 3.8 m / ridge 5.6 m, southeast extension eave 5.8 m / flat cap 6.4 m.
Replaced uniform small windows with broader repeated pale-trimmed upper facade openings guided by Purdue’s 2020 image. Exact opening sizes and elevations remain approximate.

Added broad glazed doors, side lights, surround, steps and illustrative medical emblem on the exterior frontage of the lower entrance wing, following the photo direction; exact surveyed entrance orientation is unavailable.
Preserved stable ID, .blend path, export collection, asset mesh-only collection, and campus coordinate frame.

footprint.identity: Purdue University Student Health Center (PUSH), 601 Stadium Mall Drive

footprint.status: matched to the named/addressed Purdue GIS feature

vertical_geometry.conflict: Explicit unresolved source conflict: GIS records five levels (B plus F01-F04) and fields Extrution=48 / R=69.8, while Purdue’s 2020 exterior photo appears to show three above-grade facade bands. The GIS record does not define units or these fields’ vertical semantics.
vertical_geometry.model_interpretation: Three visible facade bands are a visual reading of the photo. The 14.6304 m main ridge keeps the earlier 48 ft conversion only as one possible estimate; it is not a verified height. Wing heights and roof breaks are relative visual estimates informed by the 2023 orthophoto.
vertical_geometry.status: uncertain; no dimensioned elevations, roof plan, or documented GIS units/field semantics located

remaining_uncertainty: GIS fields NUM_LEVELS/CountOfFLO, B, F01-F04, Extrution, and R conflict with or cannot be reconciled to the photo-based visual story reading; units and semantics remain undocumented.
The three-zone roof plan is an interpretation of a 2023 orthophoto and a single 2020 oblique photo. Internal zone seams, elevations, and roof pitch are estimates.
Facade window rhythm, dimensions, entrance placement, and side/rear facade details are photo-informed estimates; no measured elevations were found.
revision_summary: Second geometry revision after independent 7.4/10 grade: added evidence-led low entry wing and lower southeast roof mass, variable wall/roof heights, photo-informed larger upper-window rhythm, and an explicit glazed entrance frontage.
